verdict.rationale: Sentry documents its own release management, deploy notifications and suspect commits, which tie issues back to specific deploys and code changes. The evidence never explicitly shows regressions being correlated with releases. Nothing covers tracking configuration or feature-flag changes; the LaunchDarkly item sends errors into LaunchDarkly rather than tracking changes in Sentry. missing for 10: explicit documentation of correlating regressions with releases or deploys, configuration and feature-flag change tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can correlate regressions with deploys and configuration changes via release or change tracking

citations.quote: Deploy notifications and source map uploads.
Suspect commits, stack traces, and PR comments.
Automatically notify Sentry of new Bitbucket Pipelines builds.
